passcode.title: Passcode
passcode.rowHint: A code to open the app
passcode.intro.title: A passcode for the app
passcode.intro.text: SkyMessage will ask for a code when you open it, so nobody but you sees your chats on this device.
passcode.intro.forgotNote: The passcode works on this device only. If you forget it, you will have to sign out and sign in again with your password.
passcode.screenshotsNote: On this device, screenshots of SkyMessage are blocked while the passcode is on: otherwise Android would show your chats in recent apps.
passcode.autoLockHint: How soon SkyMessage asks for the code after you leave the app or the screen goes off
passcode.biometric.settingHint: Open SkyMessage the way you unlock your phone
passcode.biometric.notEnrolled: Add a fingerprint or face in the phone settings first
passcode.biometric.confirmText: Then SkyMessage can open without the code
passcode.hideTextHint: While the app is locked, notifications don't show who wrote what
passcode.lockNowHint: SkyMessage asks for the passcode right away.
passcode.setup.currentHint: The code you use to open SkyMessage
passcode.setup.newHint: {0} — easy for you to remember, hard for others to guess
passcode.setup.mismatch: The codes did not match. Create one again
passcode.setup.failed: Could not save the passcode. Try again
passcode.setup.alreadySet: A passcode is already on — perhaps from another tab. Changing it needs the current code
passcode.lock.title: Enter your passcode
passcode.biometric.title: Unlock SkyMessage
passcode.biometric.unavailable: Fingerprint unlock is not available right now — enter the passcode
passcode.forgot.title: Sign out of this device?
passcode.forgot.text: A passcode cannot be recovered, but you can sign out on this device: the passcode turns off and the data kept here is removed. Your chats are stored on the server — sign in again with your username and password and everything comes back.
